evidence.description: FT232R USB-serial with K/L line drivers and OBD-II connector
OpenPort 1.3 is a documented SSM K-line interface for pre-CAN Subaru ECUs; 4800 baud serial observed in the wild

protocol.notes: Candidate only. Compatibility with the exact 1999 USDM Legacy ECU is unverified; OpenPort 2.0 targets CAN-era vehicles and is not required here.

readOnly.notes: Project operates read-only regardless of adapter capability

notes: Candidate SSM interface pending bench and vehicle verification. USB enumeration is not proof of SSM compatibility.
